questions.question: What should you check before changing lanes on a busy ring road?
options: Check mirrors and blind spots, then signal in good time
Sound your horn and move straight across
Change lanes without signalling if traffic is slow
questions.explanation: Rule 133 says check mirrors and blind spots and signal clearly first.

questions.question: When may you enter a yellow box junction while going straight ahead?
options: Only when your exit road is clear
Whenever the traffic light ahead turns green
Only if you plan to stop for five seconds
questions.explanation: Rule 174 says do not enter a box junction unless your exit is clear.

questions.question: A pedestrian is waiting to cross the side road you are turning into. What do you do?
options: Give way and let the pedestrian cross first
Turn quickly before they step off the kerb
Flash your headlights to warn them to wait
questions.explanation: Rule H2 says you should give way to pedestrians waiting to cross.
